sources.title: TinyGPT
sources.snippet: This compares desktop use. TinyGPT searches and opens pages from your device without an API key or separate search setup; the search provider and websites still receive normal web requests. Ollama and LM Studio need a model download before offline use. LM Studio Bionic is a separate app. Competitor information checked September 2026.

sources.title: tinyGPT | AI Lab
sources.snippet: What It Does tinyGPT is a character-level GPT. You point it at your own text and PDF files, it builds a tokenizer over those characters, trains on the material, and then generates text in the same style — a small, personal language model that never leaves your machine.
